in_sanskrit.name: Marimuthu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sea of Love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Marimuthu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Marimuthu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mari' which means 'sea' and 'muthu' which means 'love'. This name is associated with the divine ocean of love and devotion. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as 'Mari Muthu' and is believed to bestow his blessings upon those who invoke him with this name.

in_tamil.name: மரிமுத்து
in_tamil.meaning: One who wears a necklace of bitterness
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who bears a burden of bitterness or sadness, represented by a necklace.
